summary: Diff adds product field validation utilities, updates PDF error formatting to use underlying GenerationError.originalError (including jsPDF-not-loaded detection), and hardens PDF generation by normalizing required fields to strings before calling jsPDF text APIs. However, the requested UI behavior of explicitly listing which required fields are missing for a specific product in PDF-step errors is not clearly implemented from the provided diff evidence.

missing_requirements.requirement: When product fields are missing/blank, the displayed PDF-step error explicitly lists which fields are missing (name, subtitle, description) for the affected product, and the message is derived from GenerationError.originalError (not a generic/incorrect prompt).
missing_requirements.reason: While validation utilities can compute missing fields and formatGenerationError handles some PDF error cases, the provided formatting for invalid product data is generic (it does not enumerate which fields are missing for the affected product). Also, the diff evidence does not show the UI wiring that would surface validateProductRequiredFields/validateAllProducts messages as the displayed PDF-step error.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a helper to create a jsPDF document (createPdfDocument) beyond the requested error handling/validation/hardening changes.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not ask for a new jsPDF document factory API; only to improve error handling and robustness.
